sensors.name: left light sensor LLIGHT in %, compared with 70
line tracker brightness in %, compared with 90

control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 % (dark), steer by the line tracker: below 90 % curve left 10/30, above 90 % curve right 30/10, otherwise call avoidWalls; if not dark, call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, if LEFT sees an obstacle turn right 20°, else if RIGHT sees one turn left 20°, otherwise call driveInTheDark; if not dark, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 % drive forward at 30 %, otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left 10/40, otherwise curve right 40/10.
